title: Find the name and artist of the promotional card that has the most rulings.
question: Find the name and artist of the promotional card that has the most rulings. Also, indicate whether its set has a Korean translation.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    c.XCL_049 AS name,
    c.XCL_002 AS artist,
    IIF(
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM set_translations st
            WHERE st.XCL_093 = c.XCL_063
              AND st.XCL_092 = 'Korean'
              AND st.XCL_094 IS NOT NULL
        ),
        'YES',
        'NO'
    ) AS has_korean_translation
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
WHERE c.XCL_063 = 'PRM'
GROUP BY c.XCL_072, c.XCL_049, c.XCL_002
ORDER BY COUNT(r.XCL_087) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    c.XCL_049 AS name,
    c.XCL_002 AS artist,
    IIF(
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM set_translations st
            WHERE st.XCL_093 = c.XCL_063
              AND st.XCL_092 = 'Korean'
              AND st.XCL_094 IS NOT NULL
        ),
        'YES',
        'NO'
    ) AS has_korean_translation
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
WHERE c.XCL_063 = 'PRM'
GROUP BY c.XCL_072, c.XCL_049, c.XCL_002
ORDER BY COUNT(r.XCL_087) DESC
LIMIT 1
